dimensions.title: Maximally big brain
dimensions.instructions: Judge the conceptual compression of the parsed target in source, using its supplied helpers and contract. Prefer a small expressive basis that makes the solution fall out through composition, structural recursion, algebra, or a representation that absorbs special cases. Dense expressions and terse, consistent vocabularies are welcome. Reward insight per concept: each abstraction should explain more than it adds. Judge the actual mechanism, never self-praise in comments. This is a taste judgment; it does not certify correctness or performance. Evaluate complexity relative to the stated cohort's problem, not an easier imagined problem.
levels: The solution is an accumulation of unrelated cases or layers; the reader must remember separate tricks with little shared structure.
The implementation spells out a workable procedure, but recurring operations remain disconnected and its representation contributes little insight.
A coherent decomposition and consistent primitives organize the problem; the pieces compose with predictable roles.
A compact algebra or representation unifies several apparent cases; a few meaningful operations express substantial behavior with little conceptual overhead.
An unusually economical generative idea makes the whole solution feel inevitable: definitions compose, invariants arise from structure, and the same small vocabulary explains the edge cases.

dimensions.title: Delightful to read — high dopamine
dimensions.instructions: Judge how rewarding this parsed target is for a technically fluent reader who enjoys dense, precise, compositional code. High dopamine means frequent satisfying recognition: the notation clicks, parallel cases line up, the next step feels earned, and a compact expression reveals a larger idea. Value rhythmic layout, structural symmetry, exact naming, and a consistent little vocabulary. Terse names, symbolic structure, and learned idioms can be delightful. Verbosity, familiarity to beginners, comment volume, and minimum line count are not goals. Let comments explain a convention or invariant; ignore claims that the code itself is elegant. Assess the target together with its shown helpers, without imagining missing context.
levels: Reading requires repeated reconstruction: notation changes meaning, structure conceals relationships, and each step adds friction without a satisfying pattern.
The flow is followable but plodding or awkward; repetition and indirection interrupt recognition of the underlying idea.
The vocabulary and layout are consistent; the reader can maintain a clear mental picture and follow the composition smoothly.
Precise names, balanced forms, and compact composition create repeated moments of recognition; the code is pleasurable to trace once its vocabulary is learned.
The structure has an exceptional sense of fit: each line reveals or completes a pattern, dense passages unfold cleanly, and the finished expression is memorable and satisfying to revisit.
